summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, rights-dependent affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution; keep the gated product private, retain parked sites, and continue bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Evidence: 0 of 4 launch-readiness legal tasks are closed; upstream API access is documented but storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, and monetization rights are not; accuracy, freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Technical compliance is only a baseline: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional only where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; 4 remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Fleet compliance and data-quality disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth on sites with site-specific evidence; evidence_needed or blocked for public, rights-dependent, regulated, age-sensitive, or monetization-expanding launches. Do not block ordinary growth solely because telemetry is incomplete. Do not treat unavailable analytics as zero: source permissions or collector errors remain yellow, revenue covers 2026-09-21 only, and $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable. For the two unreachable scaffold/parked sites, retain parked status. Next evidence action for each is a timestamped private-site checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent/cookies, privacy, terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns, followed by exactly one decision: retain parked or bounded launch.

No go-live proposal is supported. Preserve the private launch gate, keep external permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization, and authorize no rights-dependent monetization, public display, alert expansion, deployment, credential change, configuration change, new telemetry, or spend. Continue only the existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, attribution-boundary, and bounded legal/security evidence work.
